kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Gross margin represents the difference between revenue and cost of goods sold.
kpis.description: Measures the direct profitability of the company's products or services.
kpis.signal: Key indicator of profitability before operating expenses.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating margin measures the profitability of the company's core operations.
kpis.description: Operating income divided by revenue, before interest and taxes.
kpis.signal: Indicates the efficiency of operational cost management.

kpis.name: R&D Investment (% of Revenue)
kpis.explanation: Research and development expenses expressed as a percentage of total revenue.
kpis.description: Indicates the portion of revenue reinvested into developing new products or technologies.
kpis.signal: Reflects the company's commitment to future innovation.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Spending dedicated to acquiring or upgrading long-term physical assets.
kpis.description: Represents expenditures on tangible and intangible fixed assets.
kpis.signal: Indicates investments in future capacity and growth.

kpis.name: Total Headcount
kpis.explanation: The total number of employees working for the company.
kpis.description: Total number of employees, including full-time and part-time staff.
kpis.signal: An indicator of operational scale and productivity potential.

risks.title: Market Risk
risks.score_rationale: Market risk is high due to the sensitivity of the company's assets and liabilities to changes in interest rates and equity prices. The company is exposed to fluctuations in equity and bond markets through its investment portfolios and variable insurance products.

risks.title: Credit Risk
risks.score_rationale: Credit risk is moderate due to the quality of the company's assets and its debtors' repayment capacity. However, the company has significant exposures to securities sensitive to credit risk and credit spreads.

risks.title: Regulatory Risk
risks.score_rationale: Regulatory risk is high due to potential changes in financial regulations and capital requirements. The company must comply with strict regulations to maintain its license and operating authorization.

risks.title: Operational Risk
risks.score_rationale: Operational risk is moderate due to the complexity of the company's operations and reliance on its systems and processes. However, the company has implemented internal controls to minimize operational risks.

risks.title: Liquidity Risk
risks.score_rationale: Liquidity risk is high due to the company's ability to generate cash flows to meet its obligations. The company has significant capital needs to sustain operations and service its debts.
